title.zh: 中国存储技术突破叠加AI估值忧虑，韩股三星、SK海力士开盘跌超7%
title.en: 中国存储技术突破叠加AI估值忧虑，韩股三星、SK海力士开盘跌超7%

current_state.zh: Korean semiconductor stocks plunged on October 13, with Samsung down 7.29% and SK Hynix down 8.35% and KOSPI falling 6.05% to 5997.99, as a CXMT memory-tech advance and AI capex-valuation doubts from Broadcom's CEO triggered heavy foreign selling and a brief sidecar halt.
